Constant upper bound (7) on the number of tokens mintable in one transaction.
Mutable maximum token supply, used as mint cap and as modulus for the starting index.
Boolean gate controlling whether minting is currently allowed.
Provenance hash offset for the token sequence, computed from blockhash.

Mapping of tokenId to per-token URI override read by tokenURI.

ERC721 mapping of tokenId to owner address, mutated by _mint/_transfer.
Ownable owner address used by the onlyOwner access control modifier.
Owner-only toggle that inverts the saleIsActive flag.
Owner-only function that transfers the whole contract balance to msg.sender.
Owner-only minting of num tokens to the owner and seeding of startingIndexBlock.
Owner-only setter that overwrites MAX_SUPPLY.
Payable public mint that validates price/supply and calls _safeMint in a loop.
Owner-only derivation of startingIndex from a past blockhash (weak randomness).
Owner-only fallback that sets startingIndexBlock to the current block number.
Internal override returning _baseURIExtended for URI composition.
Owner-only setter for the extended base URI string.
Returns the composed metadata URI for a given tokenId.
ERC721 internal safe mint that mints then validates the receiver contract callback.
ERC721 internal mint that writes _balances and _owners.
Calls onERC721Received on the recipient contract, the external callback entry point.
Ownable modifier enforcing owner() == _msgSender() on restricted functions.
Owner-only function that reassigns _owner to a new address.
ERC721 internal transfer updating balances, ownership and approvals.
Owner-only function that clears _owner, removing all owner-gated capability.
Caller-controlled address used as mint recipient, withdraw recipient and access check subject.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(balance) in withdraw, a value transfer to an untrusted address.

User supplied mint quantity validated against MAX_NFT_PURCHASE and price.

Address receiving ownership in transferOwnership.
Recipient address of minted tokens in _mint/_safeMint.
Extra calldata forwarded to onERC721Received during safe mint/transfer.
Cached address(this).balance read at the start of withdraw.

Loop counter for the mint and reserve minting loops.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the destination of the balance transfer in withdraw.
Untrusted caller address receives the contract balance through the transfer operation.
numberOfTokensMax5 drives the mint loop and the payment validation.
NFT_PRICE feeds the multiplication compared against msg.value.
mint performs the price multiplication used as value equality check.
MAX_NFT_PURCHASE bounds the requested mint quantity.
MAX_SUPPLY bounds totalSupply plus requested quantity.
saleIsActive gates whether mint can proceed.
mint invokes _safeMint which can hand control to a recipient contract.
_safeMint delegates ownership bookkeeping to _mint.
_mint increments the recipient balance in _balances.
_mint records the token owner in _owners.
_checkOnERC721Received issues the external onERC721Received call.
reserveTokens computes supply + i for each minted token id.
reserveTokens calls _safeMint inside its loop, enabling recipient callbacks.
Cached supply is the base token id for the reservation loop.
num bounds the reservation mint loop.
calcStartingIndex derives startingIndex from a past blockhash.
startingIndex must be zero before it is recomputed from block data.
startingIndexBlock seeds the blockhash used for the index computation.
MAX_SUPPLY is the modulus applied to the blockhash result.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes the current block number into startingIndexBlock.
setMaxTokenSupply overwrites MAX_SUPPLY.
maxSupply is the new value assigned to MAX_SUPPLY.
setBaseURI writes the extended base URI string.
baseURI_ is stored into _baseURIExtended.
_baseURI reads _baseURIExtended.
tokenURI calls _baseURI to obtain the prefix.
tokenURI reads the per-token URI override mapping.
tokenId selects which token metadata is returned.
onlyOwner reads _owner to compare with the caller.
onlyOwner compares the untrusted caller against _owner.
withdraw execution is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
flipSaleState execution is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
reserveTokens execution is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setMaxTokenSupply execution is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
calcStartingIndex execution is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock execution is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setBaseURI execution is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
flipSaleState inverts the saleIsActive flag controlling mint access.
transferOwnership reassigns the privileged _owner slot.
newOwner is the value assigned to _owner.
_transfer updates sender and recipient balances.
_transfer updates the token owner mapping.
withdraw executes the direct ETH transfer to the caller.
_safeMint validates the recipient through _checkOnERC721Received before returning.
The receiver callback hands execution control to an attacker-controlled contract.
Safe minting triggers a callback into the recipient contract mid-mint.
A malicious ERC721 receiver can re-enter mint while state updates are incomplete.
A malicious receiver can re-enter withdraw during the callback.
A malicious receiver can re-enter the owner reservation mint loop.
